title: Los Angeles-based artist Khamari delivers a new single "Doctor, My Eyes"
htmlContent:
Los Angeles-based, songwriter, producer, and artist Khamari returned with a new track “Doctor, My Eyes,” a song everyone can relate to. The single displays a timeless musicality and contemporary style, all without losing the honest accessibility which made him relatable from the start. As the music pumps, Khamari holds nothing back and lets his words fire off with strong substance to the pen cutting up the beat, and his conviction-filled delivery brings it all home to make sure you feel every intricacy of the record to a good level.

Khamari’s “Doctor, My Eyes” is a record that is beyond just something dope but a true culture that can stand the test of time due to the heart and soul put into the music. It is supreme in every way as you get to hear true mastery from the production to lyrics that make for a great listen for fans everywhere to enjoy.
